muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /jobs sse(Progress(ctx))" -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

// Progress streams job progress from a worker goroutine; closing the channel
// ends the stream and completes the response.
func (Server) Progress(ctx context.Context) <-chan string {
	ch := make(chan string)
	go func() {
		defer close(ch)
		for _, step := range []string{"queued", "running", "done"} {
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return
			case ch <- step:
			}
		}
	}()
	return ch
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/jobs", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if ct := rec.Header().Get("Content-Type"); ct != "text/event-stream" {
		t.Fatalf("content-type = %q, want text/event-stream", ct)
	}
	want := "data: queued\n\ndata: running\n\ndata: done\n\n"
	if got := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("body = %q, want one event per value in order: %q", got, want)
	}
}
